UI_trait_XNPDistanceRunnerDesc: Gensokyo Physique System: long-distance movement, impact escape, endurance bands, and related survival support controlled by Sandbox settings.
UI_trait_XNPPurplePhoenixDesc: Provides two independent systems: enabled Phoenix Survival recovers at critical health and pushes nearby zombies, while every actual death independently creates a Life Stock for the successor.
UI_trait_XNPGreenSkillDesc: Melee System: tiered melee power starts enabled. Right-click toggles it; double-click controls the Green world orb.
UI_trait_XNPFeastGuardianDesc: P unlocks the Red panel, dual positive modes, mark crafting, mark use, and three starter marks.
UI_XNPMarker_YellowHelp: Shows movement, endurance, and skill intensity.<LINE>Right-click: enable or disable the yellow system.<LINE>Colors: white off, green ready, blue active, yellow strong use, red maximum power/strong trigger.<LINE>Left-drag: move the marker.
UI_XNPMarker_PhoenixHelp: Right-click: enable or disable Phoenix Survival.<LINE>At 20% health, recover and push nearby zombies.<LINE>This toggle never affects Life Stock inheritance after actual death.<LINE>Left-double-click: craft one Extra Life Backup.<LINE>Left-drag: move the marker.<LINE>Blue: armed.<LINE>White: cooling down.<LINE>Green: disabled.
UI_XNPMarker_PurpleBackupHelp: Right-click: enable or disable Phoenix Survival.<LINE>At 20% health, recover and push nearby zombies.<LINE>This toggle never affects Life Stock inheritance after death.<LINE>Left-double-click: craft one Extra Life Backup.<LINE>Left-drag: move the marker.<LINE>Blue: armed.<LINE>White: cooling down.<LINE>Green: disabled.
UI_XNPPurpleCraftCancelled: Extra Life crafting cancelled: no cost or item was committed.
UI_XNPPurpleCraftFailed: Extra Life crafting failed: no item was created.
UI_XNPPurpleRestoreCancelled: Extra Life use cancelled: the backup was not consumed.
UI_XNPPurpleRestoreFailed: Extra Life restore failed: the backup was not consumed.
UI_XNPPurpleRestoreDisabledAtDeath: Deprecated message: Phoenix Survival never gates Life Stock inheritance.
UI_XNPPurpleModeEnabled: Phoenix Survival enabled: critical health will recover and nearby zombies will be pushed.
UI_XNPPurpleModeDisabled: Phoenix Survival disabled; post-death Life Stock inheritance remains active.
UI_XNPPurpleDeathModeDisabled: Deprecated message: actual death always enters the Life Stock transaction.
UI_XNPPurpleModeRearmed: Deprecated message: Life Stock restore does not change Phoenix Survival.
UI_XNPPurpleModeRearmFailed: Deprecated message: Life Stock restore and Phoenix Survival are independent.
UI_XNPPurpleModeMismatch: Extra Life display disagreed with saved state and was resynchronized.
UI_XNPPurplePhoenixBlueHelp: Phoenix Survival: enabled<LINE>At 20% health, recover fully and push nearby zombies
UI_XNPMarker_GreenHelp: Right-click: enable or disable automatic melee power.<LINE>Green, yellow, and red melee tiers are controlled by Sandbox settings; release defaults are x8, x5, and x2.5 with 3, 2, and 1 endurance cost.<LINE>Structures: release default is 20 equivalent weapon hits.<LINE>Green-state double-click: launch an inertially guided visible orb. Up to 20 independent casts may coexist per player.<LINE>Simulation and drawing use 30 Hz / 30 FPS defaults, a 12 tiles/s virtual cap, six shared lights, and a 15 second lifetime.<LINE>The explosion can damage verified undead and enabled NPC/Bandit targets; player damage is always zero.<LINE>White-state double-click: perform the configured preparation action.<LINE>Left-drag: move the marker.
UI_XNPMarker_RedHelp: Right-click: directly switch green/white mode.<LINE>Double-click: craft one Red Guardian Mark through a timed action.<LINE>Use P Point from its inventory context menu.<LINE>Green: positive stamina, fatigue, panic, boredom and unhappiness recovery plus 60 active seconds of regeneration.<LINE>White: +50 health, zombie-infection purge, and limited random wound treatment.<LINE>Blue: crafting in progress.<LINE>Left-drag: move the marker.
UI_XNPMarker_RedLocked: Requires the P trait.<LINE>The panel remains visible for discovery, but mode switching, crafting, item use, and starter items are locked.
UI_XNP_LifeStockRepairSuccess: Extra Life: inventory and equipment repaired
UI_XNP_LifeStockRepairNothing: Extra Life: nothing currently needs repair
UI_XNP_LifeStockRepairDisabled: Extra Life: right-click repair is disabled
UI_XNP_LifeStockRepairRejected: Extra Life: controlled-player identity check failed
UI_XNP_LifeStockEnabledAndRepair: Extra Life: enabled and post-toggle repair completed
UI_XNP_LifeStockDisabledAndRepair: Extra Life: disabled and post-toggle repair completed
UI_XNP_LifeStockToggleDisabled: Extra Life: manual toggle is disabled by Sandbox
UI_XNP_LifeStockToggleRejected: Extra Life: the current state cannot be toggled
UI_XNP_LifeStockToggleCommittedRepairFai: Extra Life: state changed, but some item repairs failed
UI_XNPPurpleInitialRecordDeferred: Initial Extra Life recording did not complete. Retrying in 10 seconds.
UI_XNPTestBuildNotice: XNP TEST BUILD: this version contains experimental features not yet in stable.
UI_XNPYellowAltBreakout: Emergency breakout: nearby zombies pushed back.
